# capybara-benchmark

A benchmark harness that builds and deploys five open-source JavaScript projects as git submodules. Each project is installed, compiled, and its distribution artifacts copied into a local `dist/` directory.

---

## Prerequisites

### System tools

| Tool | Minimum version | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Git** | 2.20+ | Cloning submodules |
| **Node.js** | 25.x | Building all JS projects |
| **npm** | 10+ | Bundled with Node.js; used by swup |
| **pnpm** | 11.x | Used by openplayerjs, motion-vue, zudoku |
| **yarn** | 1.22+ | Used by gridstack |
| **Python** | 3.11+ | Running `deploy.py` orchestrator |
| **uv** | 0.9+ | Python environment management |

Install pnpm and yarn via npm if not already present:

```bash
npm install -g pnpm yarn
```

Install uv:

```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
```

### Per-project tooling

| Project | Build system | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| swup | microbundle | Installed automatically via `npm ci` |
| openplayerjs | turbo + rollup | Installed automatically via `pnpm install` |
| motion-vue | vite + unbuild | Installed automatically via `pnpm install` |
| zudoku | nx + tsdown | Installed automatically via `pnpm install` |
| gridstack | grunt + webpack | Installed automatically via `yarn install` |

---

## Getting started

### 1. Clone with submodules

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules <repo-url>
# Or, if already cloned without submodules:
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

### 2. Set up the Python environment

```bash
uv sync
```

This creates `.venv/` and installs `pytest` and `ruff` as dev dependencies.

---

## Deploying projects

### Deploy all five projects

```bash
# Using the Python orchestrator (recommended):
uv run deploy

# Using the shell script directly:
bash scripts/deploy_all.sh
```

### Deploy a single project

```bash
# Python orchestrator:
uv run deploy swup
uv run deploy openplayerjs
uv run deploy motion-vue
uv run deploy zudoku
uv run deploy gridstack

# Shell scripts directly:
bash scripts/deploy_swup.sh
bash scripts/deploy_openplayerjs.sh
bash scripts/deploy_motion_vue.sh
bash scripts/deploy_zudoku.sh
bash scripts/deploy_gridstack.sh
```

### Deploy multiple specific projects

```bash
uv run deploy swup gridstack
```

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run the graph-based test generation pipeline on capybara-benchmark projects.
#
# Pipeline per project:
#   1. Discovery: --mode discovery --coverage-model graph → UI_GRAPH.json
#   2. Test gen:  --mode graph-test-gen --coverage-model graph → rq6-graph-agent/
#
# Usage: bash run_graph_pipeline.sh [repo-name ...]
#   If no repo names given, runs all projects with known ports.
#   Pass --discovery-only to skip test generation.
#   Pass --test-gen-only to skip discovery (requires existing UI_GRAPH.json).

set -uo pipefail

BENCH_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
EVAL_DIR="/Users/stephenhe/Projects/general-agent-eval"
LOGS_DIR="$BENCH_DIR/eval-logs-graph"
mkdir -p "$LOGS_DIR"

DISCOVERY_ONLY=false
TEST_GEN_ONLY=false

get_port() {
  case "$1" in
    actual)                  echo 3001 ;;
    epic-stack)              echo 3002 ;;
    hemmelig)                echo 4000 ;;
    cypress-realworld-app)   echo 3000 ;;
    mermaid)                 echo 9066 ;;
    trilium)                 echo 3010 ;;
    letterpad)               echo 3013 ;;
    keystone)                echo 3014 ;;
    react-admin)             echo 3016 ;;
    super-productivity)      echo 3017 ;;
    maputnik)                echo 3018 ;;
    altair)                  echo 3022 ;;
    git-truck)               echo 3024 ;;
    todomvc)                 echo 3025 ;;
    tldraw)                  echo 5420 ;;
    gridstack)               echo 3001 ;;
    zudoku)                  echo 4321 ;;
    motion-vue)              echo 5173 ;;
    openplayerjs)            echo 4173 ;;
    swup)                    echo 8274 ;;
    *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}

# Parse flags
REPOS_ARGS=()
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --discovery-only) DISCOVERY_ONLY=true ;;
    --test-gen-only)  TEST_GEN_ONLY=true ;;
    *)                REPOS_ARGS+=("$arg") ;;
  esac
done

if [ ${#REPOS_ARGS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  REPOS="${REPOS_ARGS[*]}"
else
  REPOS="actual epic-stack hemmelig cypress-realworld-app mermaid trilium letterpad keystone react-admin super-productivity maputnik altair git-truck todomvc tldraw gridstack zudoku motion-vue openplayerjs swup"
fi

run_repo() {
  local name="$1"
  local port
  port=$(get_port "$name")
  local project_dir="$BENCH_DIR/projects/$name"

  echo "=== [$name] Starting (port :$port) ==="

  if [ ! -d "$project_dir" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] $project_dir does not exist"
    return 0
  fi

  if [ -z "$port" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] Unknown port for: $name"
    return 0
  fi

  # --- Step 1: Graph Discovery ---
  if [ "$TEST_GEN_ONLY" = false ]; then
    if [ -f "$project_dir/UI_GRAPH.json" ] && [ "${FORCE_REDISCOVERY:-false}" = false ]; then
      echo "  [discovery] UI_GRAPH.json already exists — skipping (set FORCE_REDISCOVERY=true to override)"
    else
    echo "  [discovery] Running graph discovery..."
    cd "$EVAL_DIR"
    uv run general-agent-eval-claude-code \
      --input-dir "$project_dir" \
      --workload javascript \
      --mode discovery \
      --coverage-model graph \
      --model claude-sonnet-4-6 \
      --prompt-var "service_base_url=http://localhost:$port" \
      --max-turns 120 \
      --output-jsonl "$LOGS_DIR/discovery-${name}.jsonl" \
      > "$LOGS_DIR/discovery-${name}.log" 2>&1
    local exit_code=$?

    if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "  [WARN] Discovery exited with code $exit_code — check $LOGS_DIR/discovery-${name}.log"
      return 0
    fi

    if [ ! -f "$project_dir/UI_GRAPH.json" ]; then
      echo "  [WARN] No UI_GRAPH.json produced — skipping test gen"
      return 0
    fi

    local nodes
    nodes=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$project_dir/UI_GRAPH.json')); print(len(d.get('nodes',[])))" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
    local edges
    edges=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$project_dir/UI_GRAPH.json')); print(len(d.get('edges',[])))" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
    echo "  [discovery] Done: $nodes nodes, $edges edges"
    fi
  else
    if [ ! -f "$project_dir/UI_GRAPH.json" ]; then
      echo "  [SKIP] No UI_GRAPH.json found (run discovery first)"
      return 0
    fi
    echo "  [discovery] Skipped (--test-gen-only)"
  fi

  # --- Step 2: Graph-guided Test Generation ---
  if [ "$DISCOVERY_ONLY" = false ]; then
    # Verify server is up before test gen
    local code
    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 3 "http://localhost:$port" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
    if [ "$code" = "000" ]; then
      echo "  [WARN] Server at :$port is not responding — skipping test gen for $name"
      return 0
    fi
    echo "  [test-gen] Server at :$port is up ($code). Running graph-test-gen..."

    cd "$EVAL_DIR"
    uv run general-agent-eval-claude-code \
      --input-dir "$project_dir" \
      --workload javascript \
      --mode graph-test-gen \
      --coverage-model graph \
      --model claude-sonnet-4-6 \
      --prompt-var "service_base_url=http://localhost:$port" \
      --max-turns 200 \
      --output-jsonl "$LOGS_DIR/test-gen-${name}.jsonl" \
      > "$LOGS_DIR/test-gen-${name}.log" 2>&1
    local exit_code=$?

    if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "  [WARN] Test gen exited with code $exit_code — check $LOGS_DIR/test-gen-${name}.log"
    else
      local specs
      specs=$(find "$project_dir" -path "*rq6-graph-agent/*.spec.ts" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      echo "  [test-gen] Done: $specs spec files generated"
    fi
  else
    echo "  [test-gen] Skipped (--discovery-only)"
  fi

  echo "=== [$name] Done ==="
  echo ""
}

MAX_PARALLEL=${MAX_PARALLEL:-5}

echo "════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo " Graph Pipeline: discovery → graph-test-gen"
echo " Logs: $LOGS_DIR/"
echo " Discovery only: $DISCOVERY_ONLY"
echo " Test gen only:  $TEST_GEN_ONLY"
echo " Parallelism:    $MAX_PARALLEL"
echo "════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo ""

# Simple parallel: launch batches of MAX_PARALLEL and wait between batches
BATCH=()
for repo in $REPOS; do
  BATCH+=("$repo")
  if [ ${#BATCH[@]} -ge "$MAX_PARALLEL" ]; then
    for r in "${BATCH[@]}"; do
      run_repo "$r" &
    done
    wait
    BATCH=()
  fi
done
# Run remaining
if [ ${#BATCH[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  for r in "${BATCH[@]}"; do
    run_repo "$r" &
  done
  wait
fi

echo "All repos processed. Logs in: $LOGS_DIR/"
